Linux dependency management now presents one next action, with candidate evidence
and advanced details collapsed. LVPM requests show identified workflow progress,
failures, and log links instead of leaving users with an unexplained queued
message. Duplicate clicks are blocked while a request is pending or uncertain;
unidentified runs are never guessed from the latest build. Successful workflows
remain separate from verified candidate evidence and explicit activation. Windows
and dependency installation safeguards are unchanged.
